title: Release candidate manifest (T16, spec 17.15 / 17.26 / 17.29)
description: Manifest emitted by scripts/build-release-candidate.py for a local-only candidate. Only distribution=local-only is emittable: no verifiable signature exists (T21 unsigned), so 17.15 forbids any redistributable claim. scripts/verify-release-approval.py enforces the required subset with the standard library.

created_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 build time (17.26). Informational only: approval binds to content_id, not to this clock value, so rebuilds stay comparable.

content_id.description: Timestamp-independent candidate identity: sha256 over the canonical JSON of schema/distribution/registry_digest/registry_counts/members/gate_pins/source_lock_digest/rollback_commit. The approval record binds to this value.

distribution.description: The only emittable value while signature.present is false.

gate_pins.description: sha256 digests of the gate scripts at build time (17.21: a PR that edits a gate after approval cannot ride on that approval).

requester.description: Handle of the human requesting the release; must differ from the approver.
